name: Sir Godfrey Gwilym

source.note: Curse of Strahd's revenant knight: the revenant's numbers (data/monsters/revenant.json, 2014) with half plate (AC 17) and a longsword, as remembered. Entered from knowledge, not yet checked against the book. His weapon and any other change need the book. The extra damage against Strahd and Vengeful Glare are text only; Regeneration runs but not its pause after Fire or Radiant damage.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.summary: Regains 10 HP at the start of its turn unless it took Fire or Radiant damage since its last turn.
traits.text: The revenant regains 10 Hit Points at the start of its turn. If it took Fire or Radiant damage, this doesn't work at the start of its next turn. Its body is destroyed only if it starts its turn at 0 Hit Points and doesn't regenerate.

traits.name: Rejuvenation
traits.summary: If its body is destroyed, its soul takes another corpse within a day.
traits.text: When the revenant's body is destroyed, its soul lingers. After 24 hours the soul enters and animates another Humanoid corpse on the same plane and regains all its Hit Points. While the soul has no body, a Wish spell can send it on to the afterlife for good.

traits.name: Turn Immunity
traits.summary: Effects that turn Undead don't affect it.
traits.text: The revenant is immune to effects that turn Undead.

traits.name: Vengeful Tracker
traits.summary: Always knows the distance and direction to Strahd, the foe it hunts.

actions.name: Longsword
actions.summary: A longsword cut; 9 (1d10 + 4) two-handed, and Strahd takes 14 (4d6) more.
actions.text: Against Strahd the hit deals an extra 14 (4d6) Slashing damage.

actions.name: Vengeful Glare
actions.summary: Strahd, if seen within 30 ft, makes a DC 15 Wis save or is Paralyzed, then Frightened.
actions.text: Paralyzed until this creature damages him or until the end of its next turn; then Frightened for 1 minute (repeat save each turn). Text only for the engine.

summary: A revenant knight of the silver dragon's order: two longsword cuts, wounds that close, and vengeance sworn on Strahd.
